subject: Marketplace creative & ops handbook: packaging assets, SKU mapping and co-sell routing
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace creative & ops handbook: packaging assets, SKU mapping and co-sell routing

Hi Emily —

Thanks for agreeing to partner on the marketplace listings for CloudPartner + Redwood. To keep the AWS/GCP/Azure listings consistent and to accelerate co-sell enablement, I put together an asset and ops checklist (attached). Can you confirm the items you can provide this week and which you need us to produce? High-level asks below: 

- Creative: 2x 1200x628 banners, 1x 800x800 logo (SVG & PNG), short 200–300 word listing blurb, 3 customer bullet points
- Technical assets: deployment diagram, architecture whitepaper (PDF), SSO/OAuth notes, example connection workflow
- Pricing: list price, recommended marketplace SKU name(s), any committed discounts or rebate tiers
- Co-sell: preferred lead routing (email/webhook), named POC for field enablement, joint one-pager for sellers

Attachments: redwood_marketplace_asset_checklist_v1.pdf (contains naming conventions + upload-ready filenames).

Timing: AWS needs final creative by Oct 6 to make the October catalog update; GCP can accept up to Oct 13. Do those windows work on your side?

If you prefer, we can run a 30-min ops sync this Thursday — I can demo the naming conventions from our side and walk the checklist.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Partner Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_marketplace_asset_checklist_v1.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

Diego —

Thanks for the checklist, this is helpful. Quick answers:

- Creative: We can provide the 1200x628 banners (2 variants) and the 800x800 logo by Sep 30. We will need Redwood to produce the short listing blurb and the customer bullets — happy to review the draft.
- Technical assets: We have a deployment diagram and a short architecture PDF; attaching our current docs. We will need clarification on the SSO matrix format (IdP vs SP notes) — can you send the template?
- Pricing: We are still finalizing internal pricing tiers. I attached cp_pricing_requirements.xlsx which shows the fields AWS/GCP ops asked for (SKU, unit type, price per hour/month, meter dimensions).
- Co-sell: We prefer lead routing via webhook to our Partner Portal and a fallback email to cloudpartner-sales@cloudpartner.com. Our named POC for enablement is me (Emily Zhao).

Questions for Redwood: 
1) How do you want to name SKUs for bundled offers vs per-seat? Any examples we should follow?
2) Do you have a joint seller one-pager template? We can draft content if you send the framework.

I can do a sync on Thursday at 10am PT.

Best,
Emily Zhao
Head of Partnerships
CloudPartner Inc.

Folks —

Looping you in on CloudPartner's responses and the pricing spreadsheet they sent. Two asks from me:

1) SKU naming & packaging: Emily asked for guidance on naming for bundled vs per-seat SKUs. We have internal conventions but I want to confirm the public-facing SKU format that marketplaces prefer (example: redwood-cp-bundle-v1 vs redwood-cp-seat-monthly). Karthik — can you advise on the canonical pattern and whether we should enforce SKU IDs across AWS/GCP/Azure?

2) Co-sell ops one-pager + lead routing: Marissa/Monica — can you review and confirm the webhook payload we expect for lead ingestion into Redwood's Partner Portal? CloudPartner prefers webhook + email fallback. Also, what are the minimum fields to route to the correct AM?

Deadline: We need a consolidated asset package + SKU map by Oct 4 to meet the AWS Oct 6 drop.

Thanks,
Diego

Diego —

Short answers and next steps below. I kept this practical so we can hit the Oct 4 internal cutoff.

SKU naming pattern (recommendation):
- Public SKU: redwood-{partner}-{offering}-{term} e.g., redwood-cloudpartner-pro-monthly
- Internal SKU ID: RDW-{PARTNER_ABBR}-{OFFER_VER}-{NUM} (used for billing mapping)
- Bundles: add 'bundle' token: redwood-cloudpartner-bundle-pro-annual
- Avoid special characters, keep lower-case, and use hyphens between tokens (marketplace ingestion scripts assume this).

Pricing & Catalog fields required (we will populate from their spreadsheet):
- SKU, unit (vCPU/hr | seat/month), list price, currency, meter dimension, free-tier flag, trial length (if any)

Lead routing (webhook) — minimal payload we accept: 
- partner_name, partner_lead_id, customer_email, company_name, lead_created_at, product_sku, region, opportunity_value_estimate
- Fallback: partner should send webhook + email to cloud-partners@redwood.com with a copy of the payload

Co-sell enablement:
- We have a joint one-pager template (internal link: https://redwood-internal.share/marketplace-co-sell-template). Diego — I can drop a draft into the shared folder by Sep 30 if you give me 2 bullets of CloudPartner customer outcomes to call out.

Action items:
- Diego: consolidate final creative + listing blurb + customer bullets from Redwood by Sep 30
- Emily: provide creative assets and confirm SKU preference by Oct 1
- Karthik: confirm internal SKU mapping script can emit the RDW-{...} ID and push to billing systems by Oct 2
- Monica: confirm webhook schema and give sample webhook handler by Oct 3

I'll own the final upload checklist and verification with AWS ops.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference
